edition: Nestle-Aland 28 (NA28); German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User explicitly authorized NA28 provisionally on 15 October 2026; UBS6/ECM review remains pending.
scope: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.decision: Preserved the slave/apostle terms, faith/knowledge/godliness, hope and divine truthfulness, plural appointed times, elder/overseer/steward distinctions and every qualification. Modernized address to Titus and does not lie, and clarified paying attention. The pure/defiled repetition and both mind and conscience remain; instead restores the contrast. Also at 1:10 reflects bracketed NA28 wording; the shorter grace and peace greeting remains.

chapters.decision: Preserved rulers/authorities, gentleness toward all, the contrast between former conduct and divine kindness, mercy versus our works, washing/regeneration/renewal, Spirit poured out, justified/heirs/hope, repeated good works, two warnings, names and winter travel. Smoothed the kindness/love clause and controversies, ordinary address and has, and essential needs. Singular greetings to Titus and plural final all of you remain; no final Amen is added.
